dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: I feel like I've gotten a little stronger recently. Let's go diving for treasure again when things are less busy at the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Alright, if we're chased by any Ball Octopuses again, I'll take the responsibility and bring Urville back.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Can't you have a little faith in me? Why is it assumed from the get-go that I'm going to lose?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Well... I don't remember the exact score, but I know you have lost to the Ball Octopuses more than a few times before. Not exactly a track record that fills you with confidence.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Darn it, we should still have hope, no matter what! What doesn't kill you only makes you stronger, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: You are right. As long as we persevere, there will always be a chance of success.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Hello. Thank you for helping Urville and I take a photo earlier. Every time I see that picture, it reminds me of you.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Well... there's been good and bad.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Urville found a job at Lumidouce Harbor. It's tough work, but he says that's a good thing. He's been eating more lately, so he should be stronger than before.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: If he gets stronger, he should be able to join the Fleet without any issues. That's always been a dream of his, and I hope it comes true for him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not a problem. I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Urville aside, how are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Thank you, I can't say I've skewed too far in the direction of good or bad lately. I'm just the same as before.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Well, that's good to hear. If you ever need help, I'm willing to assist, and I'm sure Urville would be too, even though I'm not sure how much help we'd be.
